title: Sampling strategies and a KV cache
hints: sample_next: divide the logits by the temperature; top-k sets everything below the k-th largest logit to -inf; top-p sorts the probabilities descending, takes their cumulative sum and keeps the shortest prefix whose sum is >= p (np.searchsorted on the cumsum, plus one), then renormalises and draws with rng.choice.

A cache is, per layer, the K and V of every token seen so far, shaped (H, T_past, d_head). A cached step computes q, k, v only for the new tokens, concatenates the new k and v onto the cache, and attends with the new queries against the full K and V.

The new tokens sit at positions T_past..T_past+t_new-1 (that is what wpe is indexed with), and the mask for them is j <= T_past + i. generate: prefill the prompt once, then feed one token per step; without the cache, call gpt_forward on the whole sequence every step.
